in_sanskrit.name: मितोन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'mit' meaning friend, companion.

in_hindi.name: मितोन
in_hindi.long_meaning: From the Hindi words 'mitr' meaning friend and 'an' meaning without, Miton can be translated to 'one who is without friends' or 'one who is self-sufficient', depending on the context.

in_tamil.name: மிடோன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, Miton can be derived from the words 'midu' meaning friend and 'on' meaning self. This can be translated to 'one who is a friend to oneself' or 'one who is self-reliant'.

in_telugu.name: మిటొన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, Miton can be derived from the words 'mit' meaning friend and 'on' meaning self. This can be translated to 'one who is a friend to oneself' or 'one who is self-reliant'.

in_marathi.name: Miton
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Miton हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word 'Mitra' meaning friend, and 'Deva' meaning God. The name Miton signifies a friend of God.

in_bengali.name: Miton
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Friend of God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Miton একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। From the Sanskrit word 'Mitra' meaning friend, and 'Deva' meaning God. The name Miton signifies a friend of God.
